category_id.description:
Unique auto-generated identifier for this expense or revenue category.
Prefixed with EXC and used as the foreign key in financial transaction logs.

name.description:
The display name of the financial category (e.g., Rent, Salaries, Marketing).
Must be unique to prevent duplicates and is used for reporting groups.

type.description:
Defines if this category is valid for incoming funds (in), outgoing expenses (out), or both (both).
Restricts category selections in transaction entry forms.

description.description:
Additional details outlining the accounting scope of this category.
Helps administrators classify transactions consistently during entry.
